Unresolved core-floor objection: Static checked pairs have no strict triangle crossings; physical turret pivot, articulation sweeps, coplanar contact and containment remain unqualified. T158-style paired pads are visible in native front view; count, pad dimensions and return are static design choices. Guide teeth and end connectors remain absent.
